Detailed Description

prplMesh internal message broker server.

Implements a broker server that is responsible for the internal communication between the different prplMesh components (transport, controller, agent etc.)

The broker accepts connection over a SocketServer. Once connected to the server, a client can subscribe to CMDU types. Message filtering is implemented inside the server, so that clients receive only the message types they are subscribed to.
